title: Relative Velocity Vector Formula

variables.\\vec{v}_{A/B}: Velocity of body A as observed from body B
variables.\\vec{v}_A: Velocity of body A with respect to ground frame
variables.\\vec{v}_B: Velocity of body B with respect to ground frame

validity_conditions: Universal relation connecting velocities in different translating reference frames
common_misuse: Adding velocities instead of subtracting when evaluating relative velocity
